name: be going to
summaryPt: Planos já decididos e previsões com evidência.

meaningUses.en: I'm going to visit my mom this weekend.
meaningUses.enPt: Vou visitar minha mãe neste fim de semana.

meaningUses.en: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.

formation.pt: Sujeito + am/is/are + going to + verbo base.
formation.pattern: I am going to work — she is going to work

examples.en: I'm going to call my mom.

formation.pt: Sujeito + am/is/are + not + going to + verbo base.

examples.en: I'm not going to go out tonight.
examples.pt: Não vou sair hoje à noite.

formation.pt: Am/Is/Are + sujeito + going to + verbo base?

examples.en: Are you going to study tonight?
examples.pt: Você vai estudar hoje à noite?

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + am/is/are. No, + pronome + 'm not/isn't/aren't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.

examples.en: A: Are you going to come? B: Yes, I am.
examples.pt: A: Você vai vir? B: Sim.

subjectAgreement.pt: he / she / it → is going to
you / we / they → are going to

pronunciation.pt: going to em fala rápida → gonna.

commonErrors.pt: Colocar to be depois do going to

contrast.pt: be going to = plano decidido. will = decisão espontânea/previsão.
contrast.en: I'm going to visit my mom. (plano) — I'll help you. (espontâneo)
contrast.enPt: Vou visitar minha mãe. — Vou te ajudar.

examples.en: I'm going to visit my mom this weekend.
examples.pt: Vou visitar minha mãe neste fim de semana.

examples.en: We're going to have pizza for dinner.
I'm not going to go out tonight.
examples.pt: Não vou sair hoje à noite.

examples.en: Are you going to study tonight?
examples.pt: Você vai estudar hoje à noite?

guidedPractice.full: I am going to study tonight.
She is going to call you.
We are going to have pizza.

guidedPractice.prompt: Look at those clouds. It ___ going to rain.
guidedPractice.full: Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.
guidedPractice.explanation: Previsão com evidência → is going to.

guidedPractice.prompt: I ___ going to buy a new phone. (am not)
guidedPractice.full: I'm not going to buy a new phone.
guidedPractice.pt: Não vou comprar um celular novo.

guidedPractice.full: Are you going to study tonight?
guidedPractice.pt: Você vai estudar hoje à noite?
guidedPractice.explanation: Pergunta com you: Are + sujeito + going to.

guidedPractice.prompt: A: Are you going to come? B: Yes, I ___.
guidedPractice.full: A: Are you going to come? B: Yes, I am.
guidedPractice.pt: A: Você vai vir? B: Sim.
guidedPractice.explanation: Resposta curta com going to: Yes, I am.

guidedPractice.prompt: They ___ going to move next month. (are not)
guidedPractice.full: They aren't going to move next month.
guidedPractice.pt: Eles não vão se mudar no mês que vem.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I ___ going to visit my mom.
reviewQuiz.full: I am going to visit my mom.
They are going to play soccer.

reviewQuiz.prompt: It's very cloudy. It ___ going to rain.
reviewQuiz.full: It's very cloudy. It is going to rain.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Previsão com evidência → is going to.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I ___ going to go out tonight.
reviewQuiz.full: I'm not going to go out tonight.
reviewQuiz.pt: Não vou sair hoje à noite.

reviewQuiz.full: Is she going to join us?
reviewQuiz.pt: Ela vai se juntar a nós?
reviewQuiz.explanation: Pergunta com she: Is + sujeito + going to.

reviewQuiz.prompt: A: Is he going to come? B: No, he ___.
reviewQuiz.full: A: Is he going to come? B: No, he isn't.
reviewQuiz.pt: A: Ele vai vir? B: Não.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Resposta curta negativa: No, he isn't.

reviewQuiz.prompt: We ___ going to move next month. (are not)
reviewQuiz.full: We aren't going to move next month.
reviewQuiz.pt: Não vamos nos mudar no mês que vem.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I've decided. I ___ going to study medicine.
reviewQuiz.full: I've decided. I am going to study medicine.

reviewQuiz.prompt: He ___ going to buy a car. (is not)
reviewQuiz.full: He isn't going to buy a car.
reviewQuiz.pt: Ele não vai comprar um carro.
